To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ZnO films have been successfully deposited on glass substrate by sol-gel spin coating method.

ZnO thin films are polycristalline with wutrzite hexagonal structure, the thickness of the films increases when the Zinc concentration is increases, the films are homogeneous, continuous, spindle like shape, transmittance of films decrease when the Zinc concentration increase and energy band gap of film decreases slightly, when Zinc concentration increases from 0.25 m/L to 0.75 m/L and then increases when further increases from 0,75 m/L to 1.0 m
the ZnO thin films with better crystallinity and optical properties were prepared at the Zinc concentration of 0.5m/l.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of Zinc concentration on the structural and optical properties of ZnO thin films prepared by Sol-Gel method.
the preparation and characterization of ZnO thin films with different concentration of Zinc acetate by sol-gel spin coating technique.
the effect of Zinc concentration on the structure, morphology and optical properties of the ZnO thin films.

the ZnO thin film with 0 Molar concentration has the better structural, Morphology, optical properties.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ZnO thin films with 0.75 molar concentration have the best crystallinity, morphology and optical properties.
the ZnO thin films with 0.75 molar concentration of Zinc acetate have the best crystallinity and highest transmittance and energy band gap.
the film with the concentration of 0.5m/l has the highest crystallinity, the lowest transmittance and the lowest band gap.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ZnO films can be prepared by Sol-Gel spin coating technique and their properties can be tuned by varying the precursor concentration.
ZnO films prepared by sol-gel method have potential application for solar cells and optoelectronic devices.
ZnO thin films with different Zinc concentrations can be deposited by sol-gel spin coating technique.
